name: Waterbirds
description: Waterbirds - the source's single bird compartment, built from Saloum ornithological observations and weighted across piscivorous and wading (limnicole) feeding types. Almost two-fifths of their diet is macrobenthos - the worms and bivalves of the mudflats - plus small fish, shrimps and crabs; 6.3% of their food is imported from outside the modelled system, so this node's weights sum to 0.937. Functional group pooling the waterbird species observed in the Saloum, measured together.
